# iosxe_voice_class_codec (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Class Codec configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_class_codec" "example" {
  tag = 1
  preferences = [
    {
      preference = 1
      codec      = "g711ulaw"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class codec tag
  - Range: `1`-`10000`

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `preferences` (Attributes List) Set priority order for using this codec (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--preferences))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--preferences"></a>
### Nested Schema for `preferences`

Required:

- `preference` (Number) Priority order (1 = Highest)
  - Range: `1`-`24`

Optional:

- `codec` (String) - Choices: `aacld`, `clear-channel`, `g711alaw`, `g711ulaw`, `g722-64`, `g723ar53`, `g723ar63`, `g723r53`, `g723r63`, `g726r16`, `g726r24`, `g726r32`, `g728`, `g729br8`, `g729r8`, `gsmamr-nb`, `ilbc`, `isac`, `mp4a-latm`, `opus`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_class_codec.example "<tag>"
```
